title: Seawatch and Nemo Reef Monitoring
summary: This community centers around communication and coordinated monitoring efforts related to Nemo Reef. Seawatch is coordinating with Sentinel and Horizon to gather evidence – specifically water samples and vessel movement documentation – at Nemo Reef. This activity is linked to a postponed council meeting and a push for an emergency session, indicating potential urgency.
